title: Evidence composition graph topology integrity
objective: Verify that the evidence composition graph produced by the evidence plane maintains topological integrity: node counts match, edge counts match, root cause candidates are identified, and dependency levels form a valid DAG.

source.description: The composition graph defines relationships between diagnostic findings

execution.criteria: getCompositionGraph() returns valid graph with matching node/edge counts and topological levels
execution.expected_outcome: node_count == len(nodes), edge_count == len(edges), dependency_levels form valid ordering

pass_criteria.description: Composition graph node_count matches actual nodes array length
Composition graph edge_count matches actual edges array length
All edges reference valid node finding_ids
evidence_required: Every edge.source and edge.target exists in nodes
